name: representation-epoch-churn

protocol.note: For each frames_in_flight in 1..8, run_representation_churn executes the same linear RGBA8Unorm allocation through 8 transform attempts under three policies. multi-version-unbounded leaves Arena::max_in_flight_representations at 0 (unbounded) and retains every newly created MTLTexture in a host-side version ring, so peak_bytes grows with accepted transforms. backpressure installs Arena::set_max_in_flight_representations(frames_in_flight); when transform() returns false with 'in-flight representation budget exceeded', the reject is counted, the oldest ring entry is released via Arena::release_representation (producer stall), and the transform is retried -- except at frames_in_flight==1 where the sole initial representation already saturates the budget and every attempt is a pure reject with no release possible. consume-input keeps the allocation Active but releases older representations after each transform so the ring stays near the transform window (live_representations <= 2).

correctness.oracle: arithmetic: MultiVersionUnbounded peak at fif=8 exceeds ConsumeInput peak at fif=8; Backpressure peak <= frames_in_flight * version_bytes + linear_bytes; Backpressure triggers at least once across the fif sweep; fif=1 Backpressure accepts 0 transforms
correctness.tolerance: exact (integer byte counts and reject counters)

judgement: Backpressure policy is formed as an Arena-level max_in_flight_representations budget that makes transform() return false with an explicit error once live_representations would exceed the budget (catalog: 'unbounded version creation forbidden'; 'predictable failure rather than system thrashing'). Measured on real Apple Silicon: MultiVersionUnbounded peak at fif=8 exceeds the ConsumeInput peak; Backpressure keeps peak within the budgeted ring and actually reports transforms_rejected/backpressure_triggered rather than silently growing. drop/quality policy (catalog variant) is out of scope for this milestone -- it is an application-level choice once backpressure has refused a transform, not a core/Arena mechanism.
vulkan_status: compile-review-only (ADR-024/030); no Vulkan-side RepresentationEpoch churn wiring was attempted (no Vulkan hardware reachable on this host)
